thread:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary failure: deployment/encoder-service in canary namespace has 2/3 replicas CrashLoopBackOff (image: encoder:v2026.3-warmup). Rolling failures since deploy @ 3625001100
eli: I'm oncall, looking now. Paging Samira for logs.
samira: joining, pulling pods: `kubectl get pods -n canary -l app=encoder` — lots of OOMKilled + Liveness probe failures.
maya: I see this in the controller logs: "failed to allocate kv-cache" right after warmup signal. Might be a quantization path mismatch.
jordan: Support reporting user-visible 502 spikes for /generate on us-east-1. ~3% errors, some customers degraded. Ticket #INC-4789 created.
eli: Ops triage: do we want to flip the feature flag or rollback the deployment? Can we kill the canary only?
samira: Feature flag `encoder_prefetch_warmup` is currently true for canary. I can toggle to false for canary group only via launchctl.
infra-bot: HPA in canary namespace scaled replicas from 1->4 due to bursts; minReplicas=1, max=10. Rapid scale caused node pressure on gpu-node-pool-2; kubelet started evicting pods.
maya: That eviction combined with a node-drain earlier left a bunch of orphaned pods scheduled on a single node. We're hitting local GPU memory exhaustion.
eli: Immediate mitigation: pause traffic to canary route in the gateway and flip feature flag. Samira, can you toggle and disable scaling for encoder HPA (set maxReplicas=2) to stabilize?
samira: Doing now.
samira: `launchctl toggle encoder_prefetch_warmup --env=canary --off`
samira: `kubectl patch hpa encoder-hpa -n canary -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":2}}'`
ops-bot: Marking mitigation step in incident tracker.
jordan: Customers on us-east with higher traffic: 502s dropped from 3% -> 0.6% after blocking canary traffic to gateway (edge config change rolled). Logs show steady success.
maya: Still seeing a CrashLoop on pod encoder-canary-2. Suspect image runtime flag requires new CPU driver; standby workaround is to scale down canary to 0.
eli: Let's scale canary deployment to 0 and mirror traffic back to stable.
samira: `kubectl scale deployment encoder-service-canary -n canary --replicas=0`
samira: scaled. Gateway reverted route weights.
deploy-bot: Deploy rollback suggestion: `kubectl rollout undo deployment encoder-service --namespace=default --to-revision=41` if we need a full rollback.
eli: Hold on rollback for now, we removed canary and disabled the new flag; customers appear healthy. But we need RCA and a safe runbook to prevent HPA over-scaling during canary cutovers.
maya: I'll capture kernel logs + container runtime traces and open PR to add node taint to canary nodes and a prewarm healthcheck. Also propose HPA buffer on GPU nodes.
jordan: Noting affected customers: org-17, org-22 saw percent error spikes. Support reached out with mitigations and compensations if needed.
eli: Oncall handoff: I'm handing to Maya for overnight monitoring and RCA. Maya, you're now primary.
maya: Ack. Will leave detailed notes in the incident tracker: mitigation steps, timeline, and follow-ups: 1) add strict HPA limits for canaries, 2) gate warmup flag behind canary node label, 3) healthcheck prewarm probe. ETA for follow-ups: 48h.
eli: Thanks team. Closing pager for now — mark incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Closing channel in 1h if no regression.
